newsitem.title: USA: Zenith delays 1996 filing to close financing.
newsitem.headline: Zenith delays 1996 filing to close financing.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said Wednesday it will delay filing its 1996 financial statements with the Securities and Exchange Commission to reflect completion of $400 million in financing arrangements.
Zenith said it expects to complete financing arrangements totaling almost $400 million later today.

These financing include a $110 milion asset-backed credit facility, a $200 miliion trade receivables securitization, and an $87 million leveraged lease transaction, Zenith said in a statement. When these new financings become effective, Zenith said it will terminate its existing credit agreement. Details of the existing agreement were not immediately available.
Zenith also said it has scheduled its annual shareholders meeting for May 22.
Zenith is majority owned by LG Electronics Inc.
Later, a Zenith spokesman said the company's existing financing includes a revolving credit agreement with GE Capital totaling $110 million.
Shares of Zenith were trading off 1/8 to 9-7/8.
